info.title: v2.first_mile.bind_first_mile_tracking_number
info.description: Use this api to bind first mile tracking number.

post.description: Use this api to bind first mile tracking number.

parameters.name: access_token
parameters.description: The token for API access, using to identify your permission to the api. Valid for multiple use and expires in 4 hours.

parameters.name: first_mile_tracking_number
parameters.description: If using "pickup" or "self_deliver" as the shipment method the "first_mile_tracking_number" field should pass the value generated from v2.first_mile.generate_first_mile_tracking_number. If using "dropoff" as the shipment method the "first_mile_tracking_number" field should pass the tracking number provide by the supplier.

parameters.name: logistics_channel_id
parameters.description: The identity of first-mile logistic channel. If you using "dropoff" or "pickup" as shipment method, please call v2.first_mile.get_channel_list to get the logsitc_channel_id then fill it. If you using "self_deliver"as shipment method then the logistics_channel_id should be "null".

parameters.name: order_list
parameters.description: The set of ordersn. You can specify up to 50 ordersns in this call.one fm_tn maximum number of total bind orders is 10000.

parameters.name: order_sn
parameters.description: Shopee's unique identifier for an order.

parameters.name: package_number
parameters.description: Shopee's unique identifier for the package under an order. You should't fill the field with empty string when there is't a package number.

parameters.name: partner_id
parameters.description: Partner ID is assigned upon registration is successful. Required for all requests.

parameters.name: region
parameters.description: Use this field to specify the region you want to ship parcel. Available value: cn,kr. Please fill in the field according to the region of the Merchant to which the shop belongs.

parameters.name: shipment_method
parameters.description: The shipment method for bound orders, should be pickup, dropoff or self_deliver.

parameters.name: shop_id
parameters.description: Shopee's unique identifier for a shop. Required param for most APIs.

parameters.name: sign
parameters.description: Signature generated by partner_id, api path, timestamp, access_token, shop_id and partner_key via HMAC-SHA256 hashing algorithm. More details: https://open.shopee.com/documents?module=87&type=2&id=58&version=2

parameters.name: timestamp
parameters.description: This is to indicate the timestamp of the request. Required for all requests. Expires in 5 minutes.

parameters.name: warehouse_id
parameters.description: The identity of transit warehouse address. Retrieved from v2.first_mile.get_transit_warehouse_list. Note: When the first-mile delivery mode is "Drop Off", this field is expected to be a required field. However, to avoid affecting your existing services, this field will be temporarily optional until April 30, 2026. Please complete the integration before then to avoid any impact on your services if it is changed to a required field later.

parameters.name: warehouse_type
parameters.description: Warehouse type. Retrieved from v2.first_mile.get_transit_warehouse_list. 0 = normal warehouse 1 = vendor warehouse Note: When the first-mile delivery mode is "Drop Off", this field is expected to be a required field. However, to avoid affecting your existing services, this field will be temporarily optional until April 30, 2026. Please complete the integration before then to avoid any impact on your services if it is changed to a required field later.

200.description: Response documented by Shopee Open Platform.
